body: Alaska Airlines will add ten new nonstop routes between November 2026 and June 2027, according to Cirium, an aviation analytics company. Two routes begin in November, linking Phoenix Sky Harbor and Boise with Santa Rosa's Charles M. Schulz Sonoma County Airport (STS); these daily regional flights will run until mid-April on Embraer E175 aircraft from Horizon Air and SkyWest Airlines. December adds two more links to Honolulu's Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL), from Boise and Spokane, served by mainline Boeing 737 aircraft; the Boise flights run daily until mid-March and the Spokane flights until late April.

The headline additions for 2027 are four long-haul routes from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA). Alaska will launch Seattle to Paris Charles de Gaulle and Athens in May 2027 on Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners, with Paris peaking at five flights a week over the summer and Athens at three a week. Seattle to Osaka Kansai begins in mid-May, four times a week on Hawaiian's Airbus A330-200s, and Seattle to Papeete in Tahiti follows in June, three times a week on the same type. Two domestic routes complete the list: Portland to Yampa Valley Regional Airport twice a week in February and March 2027 on SkyWest E175s, and Seattle Paine Field to San Jose twice a day from mid-April 2027 on Horizon Air E175s.
en.summary: Alaska Airlines will add ten new nonstop routes between November 2026 and June 2027, according to Cirium, including four long-haul services from Seattle to Paris, Athens, Osaka and Papeete, plus new domestic and Hawaii links.

body: 根據航空分析公司Cirium資料，阿拉斯加航空將於2026年11月至2027年6月新增10條直飛航線。2026年底前先開4條：11月起鳳凰城天港機場與波伊西機場分別直飛加州聖羅莎查爾斯舒爾茨索諾馬縣機場，每日1班、由地平線航空與天西航空以E175執飛至2027年4月中；12月起波伊西與斯波坎直飛檀香山丹尼爾井上機場，以737主力機隊執飛，波伊西航線每日1班至2027年3月中，斯波坎航線至2027年4月底。
2027年長程航線集中在西雅圖塔科馬機場：5月起以787-9直飛巴黎戴高樂機場與雅典機場，夏季巴黎航線每週最多5班、雅典每週3班；5月中起以夏威夷航空A330-200直飛大阪關西機場（KIX）每週4班，6月起同型機直飛大溪地帕皮提每週3班。國內線方面，2027年2月至3月波特蘭直飛科羅拉多州亞帕谷地區機場每週2班，4月中起西雅圖潘恩機場直飛聖荷西機場每日2班，皆以E175執飛。
